name: Ghost touch
description: Trail an unseen caress across their skin from afar.
message: %USER% watches %TARGET%, who shivers as if caressed by something unseen.
%USER% traces a slow line through the air, and %TARGET%'s skin prickles.
%USER% curls %USER_PRONOUN_THEIR% fingers from afar, and %TARGET% arches slightly.
user_messages: You trail a phantom caress across %TARGET%'s skin.
You drag unseen fingertips down %TARGET%'s body from afar.
target_messages: A phantom caress trails across your skin, though no one is touching you!
Unseen fingertips drag slowly down your body!
